skills.name: Subtract common-denominator fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractional quantities that have the same denominator by subtracting numerators and keeping the denominator.

skills.name: Find LCD and convert fractions
skills.definition: Find a least common denominator for unlike denominators and rewrite fractions as equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Handle mixed and whole numbers
skills.definition: Separate whole-number and fractional parts, rewrite whole numbers with a zero fractional part when needed, borrow whole units as fractional units when necessary, and recombine the result.

skills.name: Simplify final result
skills.definition: Express the computed result in conventional lowest-term form by reducing fractions or removing a zero fractional part.
